brief:
Human Rights Watch said Israeli military attacks on April 22, 2026, in Lebanon killed journalist Amal Khalil and severely wounded another correspondent, the organization reported. Khalil, a veteran reporter for the daily newspaper Al-Akhbar, was stationed in the southern border village of Jebbayn when the strikes occurred.

The rights group characterized the attacks as apparently deliberate strikes on civilians that would constitute war crimes under international law. Human Rights Watch said the killings reflected a pattern of Israeli forces deliberately targeting journalists in Lebanon, demonstrating what the organization called a brazen willingness to commit such attacks.

title: Human Rights Watch says Israel killed Lebanese journalist in apparent war crime
